name: my-outdoors-return-visit-changes
purpose: Make saved places useful on return by surfacing only material improvements, while keeping comparison local and avoiding another homepage content block.
fatalFailures: Sends the visitor's saved-place list or local opportunity baselines to a personalization endpoint
Treats the first baseline check as a material change
Surfaces small score fluctuations as changed
Overwrites a material-change baseline before the visitor has a chance to see it
Creates a server-side user profile or cross-device identity
Adds another permanent homepage opportunity section instead of using My Outdoors
Emits saved-place names or identifiers in My Outdoors change analytics
